column1: 2.2.6.1 Multi Channel RF Unit (LB1-Shakti). Multi Channel RF Unit employs double
conversion super heterodyne technique to meet high sensitivity, spurious free dynamic
range, better image rejection and good selectivity over the frequency range of 175 – 500
MHz All the 5 independent receivers are identical in all respect for maintaining the gain and
phase matching. It consists of five-channel gain and phase matched RF Tuner, PLL
synthesized local oscillators, Calibration source (FSM), Embedded Receiver Controller
(ERC) and Power Supply Unit (PSU). These modules are mounted in an ATR form factor
chassis and it is powered from 15 Volts DC. Calibration source signal from FSM and RS422
interface commands from ERC to control ASU.
